description: Shared book definitions: identifiers, contributors, publishers, editions, edition references, and result pages. New edition metadata fields should follow the corresponding names, meaning, and shape in https://schema.org/Book, including inherited properties; document any adaptations or extensions.

identifier.description: A global or provider-scoped identifier. Shared provider identifiers may express that provider's grouping of editions.

issuer.description: Identifier namespace: a well-known global scheme token or a provider domain. Providers may use subdomains to distinguish namespaces. Compare this string exactly. Writers use lowercase global tokens and lowercase ASCII provider domains (IDNA A-labels for internationalized domains), without a scheme, path, or trailing dot.

value.description: Opaque identifier in its namespace's canonical form, defined in the proposal's identifier writing table. For isbn13, write hyphenless ISBN-13, converting ISBN-10 on write. Matching compares issuer and value exactly without parsing or normalization.

url.description: Optional canonical URL within the namespace, for display and reference only; never part of identifier comparison.

contributor.description: Someone who contributed to the work or edition in some capacity.

displayName.description: The contributor's name as it should be displayed, preserving the supplied name order. Used for display and human disambiguation; identifiers are the matching mechanism.

nameInverted.description: Optional name in filing or sorting order, when known, such as Le Guin, Ursula K. May be identical to displayName where the name is already in that order. Consumers should not infer this field by rearranging displayName.

role.description: Nature of the contribution, stored as an ONIX Codelist 17 code. The code-to-role mapping is at https://ns.editeur.org/onix/en/17. For example, A01 means author, B06 translator, and E03 narrator. Known values include all 124 codes from Issue 75. If omitted, A01 (author) is assumed. Additional values remain permitted.

identifiers.description: Identifiers denoting this contributor in global or provider namespaces, compared exactly by issuer and value.

ref.description: Optional enrichment reference. The target record type is deliberately unspecified; resolving it is never required for display.

publisher.description: The organization that published the edition.

identifiers.description: Identifiers denoting this publisher in global or provider namespaces, compared exactly by issuer and value.

editionRef.description: A self-contained book reference for reviews and other records. Cover fields are optional.

identifiers.description: Known identifiers for this edition, including provider grouping identifiers. Include the writing provider's identifier where available.

contributors.description: Contributors credited on the edition. May be empty for anonymous or unknown contributions.

cover.description: Optional cover image, strongly recommended when storing in a repository. The blob must belong to the repository containing the record, including when embedded in a review. May coexist with coverUrl.

coverUrl.description: Optional cover image URL, useful for API responses and providers without repository storage. May coexist with cover; a URL alone does not preserve image bytes in the user's repository.

series.description: Name of the series and the edition's placement within it.

position.description: Numeric position within the series, stored as a decimal string such as 6, 1.5, or 0.5. Sort numerically, not lexicographically. Applications must validate the numeric representation.

display.description: Human-readable position label preserving forms such as Vol. VI.

edition.description: Full edition metadata for books, including comic books and graphic novels, for embedding and optional repository publication. Provider APIs use editionView, which carries covers as URLs only.

identifiers.description: Known identifiers for this edition, including provider grouping identifiers. Include the writing provider's identifier where available.

contributors.description: Contributors credited on the edition. May be empty for anonymous or unknown contributions.

cover.description: Optional cover image, strongly recommended when storing in a repository. The blob must belong to the repository containing the record, including when embedded in a review. May coexist with coverUrl.

coverUrl.description: Optional cover image URL, useful for API responses and providers without repository storage. May coexist with cover; a URL alone does not preserve image bytes in the user's repository.

createdAt.description: Time this edition record or snapshot was created, not its publication date.

language.description: Language of the edition as a BCP 47 language tag.

publishedDate.description: Publication date in ISO 8601 format at its known precision: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Preserve available precision without inventing a month or day. Applications must validate the date; this is not a datetime.

format.description: Medium of the edition. Additional values are permitted; clients should provide a fallback for unrecognized formats.

pages.description: Total page count for print or ebook editions, when known.

durationSeconds.description: Total audio duration in whole seconds, when known.

chapters.description: Total chapter count, when known. This is an extent, not the reader's progress or a table of contents.

bookEdition.description: Edition statement, such as 2nd revised or Abridged.

editionView.description: Full edition metadata for books, including comic books and graphic novels, in API responses. Covers are represented only by optional coverUrl; providers omit cover and coverDid. The URL may point to a blob download endpoint.

identifiers.description: Known identifiers for this edition, including provider grouping identifiers. Include the writing provider's identifier where available.

contributors.description: Contributors credited on the edition. May be empty for anonymous or unknown contributions.

coverUrl.description: Optional directly retrievable cover image URL. May point to a CDN, image service, or a blob download endpoint including the repository and blob identifiers needed to fetch it. No separate cover or coverDid is supplied.

createdAt.description: Time this edition record or snapshot was created, not its publication date.

language.description: Language of the edition as a BCP 47 language tag.

publishedDate.description: Publication date in ISO 8601 format at its known precision: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Preserve available precision without inventing a month or day. Applications must validate the date; this is not a datetime.

format.description: Medium of the edition. Additional values are permitted; clients should provide a fallback for unrecognized formats.

pages.description: Total page count for print or ebook editions, when known.

durationSeconds.description: Total audio duration in whole seconds, when known.

chapters.description: Total chapter count, when known. This is an extent, not the reader's progress or a table of contents.

bookEdition.description: Edition statement, such as 2nd revised or Abridged.

editionResults.description: Shared response envelope for search and single-book resolution.

items.description: Full edition views in provider-defined relevance order, with URL-only covers. Preserve known identifiers, including the provider's identifiers; do not reduce them to only those supplied in the request.

hasMore.description: Whether more matching editions remain after this page. Must be false for an empty page.

total.description: Optional total number of matching editions before pagination, not the size of this page. Omit if not known.
